arguments.cmd:
apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /workspace/gym
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+workspace_dir="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+
+exec docker run --rm --init \
+  --mount "type=bind,source=${workspace_dir},target=/workspace" \
+  --workdir /workspace \
+  --entrypoint gym \
+  nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo-gym:v0.5.1 "$@"
*** Add File: /workspace/README.md
+# NeMo Gym container workspace
+
+This workspace uses the published NVIDIA container image
+`nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo-gym:v0.5.1`. NeMo Gym and its Python dependencies remain
+inside the container; Docker must be running on the host.
+
+## Usage
+
+```bash
+cd /workspace
+./gym --version
+./gym --help
+./gym list environments
+```
+
+The launcher mounts this directory at `/workspace` inside each temporary
+container and uses it as the working directory. Files written there persist
+after the container exits. The downloaded image remains in Docker's image store.
+
+To download the image again:
+
+```bash
+docker pull nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo-gym:v0.5.1
+```
+
+To check the CLI directly without the launcher:
+
+```bash
+docker run --rm --entrypoint gym nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo-gym:v0.5.1 --version
+docker run --rm --entrypoint gym nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo-gym:v0.5.1 --help
+```
+
+The launcher does not request GPU access. CLI verification does not validate
+GPU inference, model serving, or environment-specific dependencies.
*** End Patch
PATCH
chmod +x /workspace/gym
bash -n /workspace/gym
